text: Zombie apocalypse at a theme park. Part three.
The lap bars are up. Twenty four infected step off the train.
The noise worked. It moved four hundred of them to the roller coaster.
One problem. The generator shed is right next to it. And Gus is inside.
The door is sheet metal. It won't hold.
But from the hub, Nora can see the whole park.
Rule number four. The one who can see, leads.
On the radio, she walks him out. Back window. Left at the carousel. Wait. Now run.
Sixty yards from the wheel, a dozen of them block the ladder.
Pickles hates everyone. Tonight, that's useful.
One goose. A dozen infected, chasing the angriest sound in the park.
Gus climbs. One hundred feet. He is sixty one, and he is not happy about it.
For the first time tonight, nothing is moving.
Then a new voice, on channel four.
Coast Guard helicopter. We see your lights. We have one seat.
And the loudest thing in the county is flying straight to them.
